questions.question: Which one is not the function of single transistor

explanations.a: Amplifying is a basic function of a transistor.
explanations.b: Switching is a common use of transistors in digital logic.
explanations.c: Voltage division is typically done using resistors, not a single transistor.
explanations.d: Transistors can be used in differentiator circuits but typically not alone.

questions.question: Which layer is the most thin depletion layer in transistor?

explanations.a: Collector-base junction is reverse-biased and has a wider depletion region.
explanations.b: This is not a junction in terms of depletion layers.
explanations.c: Correct—base-emitter junction is forward-biased, so it has the thinnest depletion layer.
explanations.d: Incorrect—only base-emitter has the thinnest depletion layer.

questions.question: What is the minimum requirement for developing an oscillator

answers.d: Tank circuit and feed back network

explanations.a: A tank circuit alone cannot maintain oscillation.
explanations.b: Amplifier is necessary but not sufficient alone.
explanations.c: Needs a feedback network to sustain oscillations.
explanations.d: Correct—oscillator requires both a tank circuit and a feedback network.

questions.question: What is the importance of feedback network

answers.b: To provide input to the amplifier

explanations.a: Correct—feedback sustains oscillation in the tank circuit.
explanations.b: Partially true but not the primary function.
explanations.c: Gain comes from the amplifier, not the feedback alone.
explanations.d: Damping is related but not the core reason for feedback.
